source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of data backup and recovery (PDF 20-21).

blocks.text: Data backup ka matlab ahem data ki nakal banana hai taake woh zaya ya kharab hone se bache, maslan virus ya hardware ki kharabi se. Backup data ko asani se bahal karne deta hai; recovery data wapas hasil karne ka amal hai. Har user ko baqaidagi se data ka backup lena chahiye.

blocks.caption: Data backup ki qismein
rows: Sirf woh data jo kisi bhi pichhle backup ke baad badla
Aakhri full backup ke baad ki tamam tabdeeliyan

blocks.text: Backups hard drives ya cloud storage mein rakhe ja sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar Itwar se Budh tak din. Qitar full har roz: har din 'all data' dabba. Qitar incremental: Itwar 'all data', phir chhote barabar dabbe 'sirf Pir', 'sirf Mangal', 'sirf Budh'. Qitar differential: Itwar 'all data', phir 'Itwar se' dabbe jo har din chaure hote. Note: incremental sab se chhota aur tez magar bahali ko full backup aur har baad ka hissa chahiye; differential har din barhta magar bahali ko sirf full aur aakhri differential chahiye.
blocks.caption: Chaar dinon mein full, incremental aur differential backups (asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Intikhab har backup ke waqt aur jagah, aur data bahal karne ke liye darkar hisson ki tadaad ke darmiyan saude-bazi (trade-off) hai.

items: Gum shuda data bahal karne ke liye backup files use hoti hain.
Recovery software delete shuda files wapas lane mein madad deta hai.
System restore system ka data wapas la sakta hai.
Mahireen kharab devices se data nikal sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Itwar ko full backup aur Pir, Mangal aur Budh ko incremental backups liye gaye. Jumeraat ko disk kharab ho gayi. Data bahal karne ke liye kaun se backups chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Itwar ka full backup aur teeno incremental backups (Pir, Mangal aur Budh), tarteeb se. Differential backups ke saath sirf Itwar ka full aur Budh ka differential chahiye hota.

items: Backup: ahem data ki nakal; recovery: use wapas lana.
Full: sab kuch; incremental: aakhri backup ke baad ki tabdeeliyan; differential: aakhri full ke baad ki tabdeeliyan.
Recovery: backup files, recovery software, system restore, mahireen.
